title: Mondo Of Dogomonno - Planet Zesta V 1.0
author: Vedek Bheemaiah
description:
The story is set on Planet Zesta, of the Quinta Galaxy.
Dogomonno is a reclusive Zestian, a race of technologically teleporting and telepathic sentients. In this episode he takes part in his 'Mundo' or sacred journey across the 'Gap' to the next world, beyond the wormhole aliens and wiggly light sentients, Zestians worship.
My blog has more stories.
This is a new genre of mathematical science fiction and mathematical metaphysics.
